name: Computer Science
tagline: Every BSc and MSc CSE course in full, about 100 pages each.
description: The full CSE degree, grouped by year: one course per level, about 25 lessons each, from Introduction to Computer Systems to the MSc thesis. Courses open one after another.

messages.welcome: This is the full course, one topic per lesson. Take one lesson a day and you'll finish a course in about a month.
messages.comeback: Your next topic is waiting. Read just the first few paragraphs today.
messages.pass: Nice! One more topic you really understand.
messages.fail: No problem. Read the explanations, go through the lesson again and retry.
messages.finished: You finished every course here. Go build something with it!
